mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion that may potentiate atazanavir's effects on cardiac conduction and increase risk of hypotension; atazanavir may inhibit renal tubular secretion of bumetanide via CYP3A4 and hepatic metabolism pathways.
action: Monitor electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), renal function, and blood pressure regularly; consider ECG monitoring; adjust diuretic dose if necessary and ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
